name: Bank Rakyat Johor Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Bank Rakyat Johor Half Marathon 2026 is on Saturday 7 November 2026 in Iskandar Puteri, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Bank Rakyat Johor Half Marathon 2026 is a Saturday race in Iskandar Puteri, Johor, on 7 November 2026, with registration on JomRun. It offers a 21.1 km competitive run with a TrackAsia RFID timing chip and 5 km and 10 km fun runs. JomRun lists the event time as 3:45 am; the exact start venue and route map are still marked to be updated.

faqs.question: When and where is the Bank Rakyat Johor Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The race is on Saturday 7 November 2026 in Iskandar Puteri, Johor. JomRun lists the event time as 3:45 am, and the exact venue and route map are still to be updated on the event page.

faqs.question: What is included for 21.1 km runners?
faqs.answer: The 21.1 km competitive run entitlement includes an Ultron event jersey, a race bib with a TrackAsia RFID timing chip, an e-certificate, personal accident insurance and light refreshments. Finishers also receive a finisher medal and an Ultron finisher jersey.
